temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan initially questions Christian's suspicion but then admits he has been keeping something from Christian and that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him, which makes him anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Christian's suspicion is confirmed: Jonathan admits he has been hiding something and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan was indeed hiding something important; he is in some kind of trouble, though Christian does not yet know the details.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious before, then worried and concerned after the admission.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To learn more about Jonathan's trouble and determine how to support him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian into it, but eventually accepts that he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is in trouble and needs help, but does not know whether Jonathan will accept his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Jonathan is willing to accept help and admits he needs support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in a complicated trouble and needs Christian's support and resources to resolve it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support, and to face the situation together with Jonathan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure, might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denies doing anything illegal himself; Christian says he will look into it discreetly and Jonathan trusts him to do so.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is in serious trouble and suspects it may be related to criminal activity or the wrong people.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — the suspicion is partially confirmed and refined: Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people, though he denies committing any illegal act.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be involved with dangerous or criminal people and could be in danger, but he claims he did not do anything illegal; Christian needs to investigate discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly to learn the truth and ensure Jonathan's safety without alarming him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed and someone is trying to set him up; he tells Jonathan this and says he has leads to gather more evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan may be entangled with wrong people but denies wrongdoing, and Christian is investigating the situation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Christian learns that Jonathan is not the wrongdoer; Jonathan is being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is the victim of a frame-up; Christian needs to clear his name by gathering evidence.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Determined, protective, and concerned or indignant.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather more evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian finds out who is behind the frame-up and tells Jonathan it is someone they both know and trust; Christian says he will confront the culprit and bring them to justice, while Jonathan warns him the person is dangerous but trusts him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is being framed, but the real culprit is still unknown.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — the real culprit is identified as someone close to both Christian and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: A trusted mutual acquaintance is responsible for framing Jonathan, and Christian has been betrayed by someone close.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice, ensuring the betrayal does not go unpunished.
